summary: Iteration 11 (combo edit/swap/inventory) tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (GET combo config, add-combo single line, update-combo swap+qty preserves line, qty clamp, disallowed swap 400, remove combo, COD/ASAP order with combo). Frontend Playwright verified: base price + You Save show correctly, +/- stepper bounded (dec disabled at min=1, inc disabled at max=3), fixed-qty item has no stepper, price updates live when qty changes (₹500→₹1,898 at qty 3) and when swapping to Kolam Rice (₹1,061), Swap dialog shows original + admin-approved alternatives with +/-₹ diff, Add Combo to Cart creates exactly ONE bundle line in the drawer with combo name/effective price/Save badge/item list, Edit action navigates to /combo/:id?line=<id> with prefilled qty and 'Update Combo' button label, Update preserves the same line_id (no duplicate), Remove clears the combo line.

integration_issues.issue: After 'Update Combo' the code calls navigate('/checkout') but the app redirects to /offers (checkout likely bounces due to missing/invalid address selection or auth session). Update itself works and cart still shows single line, so functional impact is low but the UX intent is broken.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription (a11y warning in console)
React warning: empty string passed to when combo.image_url is missing; render null instead of empty src

action_items: Investigate why /checkout redirects to /offers after combo update (address selection / cart location mismatch).
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the Swap dialog to fix a11y warning.
Guard to avoid empty-string src warning.
critical_code_review_comments: packages.price_and_validate_combo clamps qty silently to min/max; frontend never sends >max because stepper is bounded, but a malicious client could send any qty and it will just be clamped (accepted behaviour, but consider 400 for out-of-range to help debug).

cart.add_combo does not deduplicate identical combos (same combo_id + same selections) into one line. Requirement states 'edited combo stays as ONE bundle line' — currently EACH add creates a new line. If PM wants merge-on-identical, add logic.
build_cart_response silently 'continue's on inactive combo package or pricing exception — could hide errors from users. Consider surfacing a warning line.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Combo requirement #5 flows are stable. If regressions appear, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_combo_edit_iter11.py. Frontend cart-button opens drawer with data-testid=cart-drawer; combo bundle lines are cart-combo-<line_id>.
